instructions.content: NEVER run Biome and ESLint on the same files; route TS linting and formatting through Biome only
NEVER run Prettier and Biome formatter on the same files
NEVER skip `biome.json` customization after init; define formatter width, linter domains and VCS ignores explicitly
NEVER blanket-ignore diagnostics to get green CI; use narrow suppressions with a reason and follow-up ticket
NEVER leave ESLint or Prettier wired in after migrating; remove the old scripts and dev dependencies
NEVER run the CI check without `--error-on-warnings`
NEVER add a suppression without a reason
NEVER re-enable every rule group at once when isolating a failure; re-enable one group at a time
NEVER declare success without re-running the check and confirming the exit code
Use one source of truth for linting and formatting
Prefer deterministic commands and verifiable output
Keep SKILL.md short and move deep details to references
Confirm the scope first: migration, config, lint, format or CI
Initialise the config if missing with `bunx @biomejs/biome init`
Run `bunx @biomejs/biome check .` and capture the results
Apply safe autofixes with `bunx @biomejs/biome check . --write`
Add targeted suppressions only when justified
Verify commands pass in local and CI contexts, with `--error-on-warnings` for CI
On a failure after migration, isolate conflicting rules by temporarily disabling rule groups in the linter section
Normalise formatting with `bunx @biomejs/biome format . --write`
